messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Installation/compilation problem
parts:
On Saturday, September 3, 2016 at 2:34:20 AM UTC-4, yohei tanaka wrote:
> fx <- inline::cxxfunction( signature(x = "integer", y = "numeric" ) , '
+     return ScalarReal( INTEGER(x)[0] * REAL(y)[0] ) ;
+                            ' )
clang++: not found
make: *** [file168c5cc11056.o] Error 127

Windows does not support the clang++ compiler. Open the result of

file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".R", "Makevars")
in a text editor and delete everything except the line

Then it will work. You don't need to reinstall anything.

Ben
